notes.title: Demo v0.9.0 is LIVE - Casual Mode Update
notes.content: [p]Hi [b]Consonance Players[/b],[/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are enjoying the Demo. I'm excited to announce that Demo v0.9.0 is now LIVE.[/p][p]This update contains the Casual Mode, a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down for a more relaxed experience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changelog:[/h3][list][*][p]Casual Mode - a special mode where puzzle animations are slowed down[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Next Level" button on completion of a level[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels' animations were slowed down[/p][/*][*][p]Minor animation changes in some levels[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]For any feedback and bug reports, please visit the Consonance Community Hub.[/p][p]Thank you and have a great day.[/p][p][/p][h3]James Filomar[/h3][p](Developer)[/p]
